permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Voice (Groq); answers and search (Gemini); weather (Open-Meteo); rates; maps (Esri/OSM); places and routes (OSM, OSRM, Photon); transit; scores; crypto; aircraft (adsbdb, adsb.lol); ISS; facts (Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo); OSM links; your Google Apps Script (calendar, planes); smart home webhooks.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records from the glasses microphones while you talk to Jarvis, for live captions, meeting notes and the voice-following teleprompter, and, if you turn on hands-free, to listen for "Jarvis".

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Shows where you are on the map, finds nearby places and emergency services, gives walking directions, tracks walks and runs, saves pins and location reminders, warns of rain, finds transit, and identifies planes overhead.
